description: Check what powers a contract's deployer still holds before you interact with it: mint, blacklist, pause, fee changes, and upgradeability (EIP-1967, legacy zeppelinos, EIP-1822 proxies). Complements a sell simulation — that proves a token is sellable NOW, this asks whether someone can change that afterwards. Read-only eth_getCode/eth_getStorageAt; never returns 'safe', only 'unknown-risk', 'elevated', or 'high', because absence of a selector is not proof of safety.
name: contract_risk_scan
